description: Mandatory deterministic fixture (CLAUDE.md, docs/07 §3). Canonical state hashes for the fixed seed + DEFAULT_CONFIG + empty command log. Intentional engine behavior changes require an ENGINE_VERSION bump, regenerated hashes (pnpm headless --seed 0xE0A12026 --ticks 10000 --checkpoints 0,1,10,100,1000,10000) and a CHANGELOG entry. Engine 0.4.0 regenerated every hash: reproduction adds three hashed counters plus a per-slot reproduction cooldown to the stream, and phase 14 makes the population grow instead of dying out, so ticks 1 onward describe a different world as well as a different stream. The tick-1000 hash is unchanged by coincidence of the stream layout, not by design.
